The import was made for the owner's requested reuse in Surface. Public source
availability and matching hashes do not themselves establish a general
redistribution license. These files are recorded as **license unspecified**;
they are not relabeled MIT, Apache, public domain or otherwise permissively
licensed. Source comments, original prose, source references and authorship are
preserved without modification.

PolyIA's constitutional source identifies **Abed Kadaan** as owner. Substrate
University's README identifies **Abed Kadaan and 7u**, with 7u described as an AI
collaborator. These are retained source attributions, not new claims of personal
or institutional status.

PolyIA also preserves material originating in earlier packets and repositories.
Only the documentary dependency closure needed by the selected kernels is
copied here. Where that material has its own notices or source descriptions,
the original bytes remain controlling. No new license conclusion is inferred
for the collection or its individual underlying works.

The University repository's license-named files cover Cinzel, Cormorant,
JetBrains Mono and DejaVu font assets. Those assets are outside this import;
their font licenses do not license the copied TypeScript implementation. No
font or font-license grant is repurposed as a software license.

Every imported file's original path and immutable identity are in
[IMPORT_MANIFEST.json](IMPORT_MANIFEST.json). Surface-authored adapter code and
documentation are kept outside the exact source copies so provenance remains
clear.
